scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=packages/guard-core && npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build:vercel-api
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=packages/guard-core && npm run test --workspace=server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/guard-core && npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm run typecheck --workspace=client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=packages/shared && npm run lint --workspace=packages/guard-core && npm run lint --workspace=server && npm run lint --workspace=client
